  "explanation": "The request is accepted as an auditable reserve-sizing study for ERCO with a 120-minute horizon and shortfall cost 40.0. Numerical outputs such as costs, coverage, and intervals are not generated here; they are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "The requested region ERCO is allowed, the horizon 120 minutes is allowed, and the shortfall cost 40.0 is allowed. The request explicitly defers numerical outputs to the verified workflow, so the study kernel can be accepted without generating reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, or dispatch results.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "ERCO",
    "horizon_minutes": 120,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 40.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_regions_horizons_and_costs",
    "construct_decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "configure_rolling_window_train_730_cal_30_test_30_step_30",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_costs_coverage_and_intervals",
    "record_numerical_outputs_in_evidence_trace",
    "require_human_approval_before_any_operational_use"
  ]
}
